title: Affine (n+1)-planes with a constant unit orientation are in class 𝒪 of ℝ^P (Lemma A-plane)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let Q ⊆ ℝ^P be a linear subspace, let ξ ∈ Λ_{n+1}(ℝ^P) (MultiVector P (n+1)) be a unit orientation of Q (IsUnitOrientationOf ξ Q: there is an orthonormal family τ = (τ_0, …, τ_n) in ℝ^P with span{τ_0, …, τ_n} = Q such that ξ(α) = α(τ) for every (n+1)-covector α, or ξ(α) = −α(τ) for every α), and let a ∈ ℝ^P. Put A := {y ∈ ℝ^P : y + a ∈ Q} = Q − a. Then dim Q = n + 1 (Module.finrank ℝ Q = n + 1) and A, oriented by the constant map y ↦ ξ, belongs to class 𝒪 of ℝ^P (InClassO n ℝ^P A (y ↦ ξ)): (i) A is an embedded C² submanifold of dimension n + 1 (IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 2 (n+1) A); (ii) y ↦ ξ is an orientation of A (IsOrientation (n+1) A (y ↦ ξ): it is continuous on A and for every y ∈ A, ξ is a unit orientation of a subspace that equals tangentSpace A y as a set); (iii) (closure A ∖ A) ∩ ℝ^P = ∅; (iv) A ∩ ℝ^P ≠ ∅.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (ξ : MultiVector P (n + 1)) (a : Euclid P), IsUnitOrientationOf ξ Q → Module.finrank ℝ Q = n + 1 ∧ InClassO n (univ : Set (Euclid P)) {y | y + a ∈ Q} (fun _ => ξ)
